notFound: This truck is not on this device
woCheckFailed: Could not load work orders — retry
goToOpenWo: A work order is open — go to it
manyOpenWos: Open work orders on this truck: {{n}} — all listed below under “Work orders”
noClassTitle: This truck has no maintenance class
noClassBody: The class decides which preventive-maintenance plans apply to the truck. Until a class is chosen, nothing is tracked for this truck and it does not appear on the due board.
classExplain: This class's preventive-maintenance plans apply to the truck.
classNoPlans: This class has no maintenance plans yet, so nothing is tracked for this truck.
goToPlans: Open Settings to set up classes and plans
classNeedsSupervisor: Only a supervisor can change the class.
classCleared: Class removed — this truck is no longer tracked
clearClassTitle: Remove the maintenance class from this truck?
clearClassBody: The truck leaves the class “{{name}}”. Its maintenance stops being tracked and it disappears from the due board. Recorded work stays as it is, and you can choose a class again at any time.
pickClassBody: The class decides which preventive-maintenance plans apply to the truck.
noClassesYet: No maintenance classes have been created yet.
noOtherClasses: There is no other class besides the current one.
classChangeWarn: The truck moves from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”. The new class's plans will apply and due dates are worked out again from them.
classSetWarn: The plans of “{{to}}” will apply to the truck and it will appear on the due board.
dueMore: {{n}} more need attention — see them all
dueAllFine: All maintenance is on schedule — nothing is needed now
dueNoPlans: No maintenance plans apply to this truck — its class has no plans yet. Plans are set up in Settings.
wosEmpty: No work orders for this truck yet
odometerNone: No odometer reading for this truck — maintenance counted in km cannot be worked out until one is entered.
overrideBody: Type what the truck's odometer shows now. Maintenance counted in km is worked out from this number.
overrideSame: That is the current reading — nothing to correct
overrideDownWarn: This is below the current reading. If it is right, the app will use it and ignore older readings until the truck passes it.
overrideJumpWarn: This is {{km}} above the current reading — check you did not type an extra digit.
overrideNoteMissing: The change is large — write the reason
overrideConfirmDownTitle: The new reading is below the current one — are you sure?
overrideConfirmJumpTitle: A large jump in the odometer — are you sure?
overrideConfirmBody: The odometer changes from {{from}} to {{to}}, and due dates are worked out from the new number.

history.empty: No maintenance history for this truck yet
history.emptyHint: If you expect service invoices, press “Refresh history” while connected.
history.filterPlaceholder: Search the history: work, driver, date…
history.summary: Workshop work orders: {{wos}} · Service invoices: {{loaded}} of {{total}}
history.filterLoadedOnly: The search covers only what is loaded — load older records to search them too
history.loadMoreFailed: Could not load older invoices — try again
history.invoiceMissing: This invoice is not on this device
history.invoiceMissingHint: Go back to the history and press “Refresh history” while connected.
